newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Lend Lease budgets for profit rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Lend Lease budgets for profit rise.

text.p: Property and financial services group Lend Lease Corp Ltd said on Friday it was budgeting for an increase in profit after tax and earnings per share in the current year ending June 30, 1997.

"Lend Lease continues its transition from a domestic to an international company in all its core businesses; is well positioned to take advantage of further opportunities as they arise globally; and is budgeting for an increase in profit after tax and earnings per share in the 1996/97 financial year," Lend Lease managing director David Higgins said in a statement releasing the 1995/96 results.
Lend Lease posted a net profit after tax of A$280.0 million for 1995/96, up from A$260.10 million the previous year. It set a 47 cent final dividend, up from 38 cents the previous year.

"However, the overall (property services) result has been adversely affected by A$57 million after tax of provisions for valuation shortfalls on Greensborough and Dandenong Retail shopping centres in Victoria," Lend Lease said.
The two centres were sold in 1989 and 1993 respectively to long term investors at prices reflective of retail sales and rental levels expected to be achieved at an agreed time after opening, it said.
"The reality was below expectations, reflecting the low level of retail sales being experienced generally in Victoria."
